t: MIA-ACCA JES Students’ MeetUp: Inspiring Students on their Academic Journey
html:
The Malta Institute of Accountants (MIA) and the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) will be hosting an MIA-ACCA JES Students’ MeetUp event, designed to motivate and inspire students as well as individuals already in employment, by providing them with key insights relevant to their career or study journey, as well as an invaluable opportunity to network with MIA and ACCA representatives, ACCA Approved Learning Partners and fellow students.

The MIA-ACCA JES Students’ promises to be an engaging and informative event for all attendees. With a focus on empowering students, the MeetUp aims to equip them with the necessary tools and knowledge to excel in their academic pursuits, particularly for those individuals, young or otherwise, that are considering the ACCA route for an accountancy career.

Among the highlights of the event, Global Prizewinners, who have excelled on a global level, will share their journey in what will be an inspirational experience for existing, prospective and mature students alike.

The MeetUp will also provide an exceptional networking platform as attendees will have the opportunity to connect with foreign representatives from ACCA, who will be on hand to offer guidance and support regarding their career aspirations.

Students who are already on an ACCA pathway will also benefit from exclusive insights, resources and practical tips. On the other hand, prospective students who are considering this specific path towards an accountancy qualification will discover more on the extensive opportunities that are opened up for accountancy graduates in a myriad of economic niches, as well as the chance to connect with ACCA tuition providers.

“We are thrilled to host the MIA-ACCA JES Students’ MeetUp, as it embodies our commitment to supporting and empowering students on their educational journey,” said Maria Cauchi Delia, MIA CEO. “This event is designed to provide students with key insights, networking opportunities, and a platform to connect with professionals in the field. We believe it will inspire and motivate students to reach their full potential”, she added.

Magda Krupa-Hernandez, Director of ACCA Europe, Eurasia, Middle East and Americas added: ”ACCA is a globally recognised and respected professional accounting qualification, opening doors to diverse career opportunities around the world. We are delighted to showcase how ACCA can offer a a flexible study pathway which allows students to learn at their own pace while gaining practical skills and knowledge that are highly sought after by today’s employers”.

Students, as well as individuals already in employment who are considering a career change or want to upgrade and upskill their capabilities are encouraged to mark their calendars and reserve their spots for this unique opportunity to gain valuable knowledge, connect with industry experts, and network with peers.

This event will be preceded by a Tutors Development Day, in which the MIA and ACCA will offer key insights to support the progression of MIA-ACCA JES Students. The MIA-ACCA JES Students’ MeetUp will be held on Wednesday 14th June 2023 at 5pm at Villa Arrigo in Naxxar. Further details and registration, which is free of charge, are available on https://www.miamalta.org/smu.  For further information, kindly reach out on js@miamalta.org
